description: A Penn tennis-ball canister sits on the tabletop in the corner, and a few loose tennis balls end up on the table nearby. The left hand reaches in to pick up the canister while the right hand comes to the lid; together they open it, tip the can so tennis balls slide out into the right hand and onto the tabletop, then the right hand snaps the red lid back on while the left hand holds the can steady before setting it back down.
